claim_limits: This evidence supports W2.0 INTERNAL_EVIDENCED only. It does not support Gate D4.2, V1-P0 or V1-Full.
The five Wave 2 routes are still 404 and were asserted so; nothing here claims materialize, impact, adopt or restore exists.
evidence:wave1:integrity exits 1 here by design: it asserts no code moved after the Wave 1 freeze, and W2.0 moved code. Its output is recorded verbatim and is NOT a pass.
evidence:wave1:historical is the tamper gate: it reads the frozen commit's tree and exits 0. The original integrity tool is byte-for-byte unchanged.
The independent external review of the Wave 2 combined freeze has not run. This implementation session cannot sign it.
The M2.3 harnesses satisfy the ledger's frame cross-check with a constant probe. The disagreement case is proven in tests/wave2/w2-asset-ledger.test.ts, not in the M2.3 suites.

The full suite is not reproducible on this machine: check fails intermittently on a filesystem call under parallel load. Every attempt is kept in check-<n>.txt and summarised in check-summary.txt, which reports raw facts rather than a verdict. One attempt failed on w2-host-composition.test.ts with a 500 whose cause the Host normalizes away, and that test passed four times out of four in isolation. It is recorded as cause=unknown, not dismissed.
Only four of the thirteen W2.0 cases are proven through NarralensHost; the rest are component-level. w2.0-cases.json states which is which per case.

Two guards inside AssetInventoryPort (no bootstrap record; active record with zero rows) are defence-in-depth behind reverify and are not independently provable, because a valid bootstrap can produce neither state.
